BiblicalUsage: Strong, or strength itself, and the Bible uses it for the strength that cannot be matched. Lift up your eyes on high, Isaiah says, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth. And Job asks, If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
TheologicalSignificance: A word for strong carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the question, that if the strength is His, who will set the time to plead against Him?
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
